deep_model_pair_balanced_accuracy.definition: mean(SlowHTTPTest recall, FTP-BruteForce recall) on the test split (descriptive only)

pair_separability_evidence.key_comparison: A trivial linear probe on the same 77 features reaches ~0.682 balanced accuracy on the pair, equal to or higher than the deep hierarchical model (0.667-0.675). The deep nonlinear model has therefore NOT left separability on the table; the 77-D feature space itself caps achievable separation at ~0.68 balanced.

smd_summary.note: Only one effective axis (packet rate, expressed by three near-duplicate features) meaningfully separates the classes; 74/77 features are weak (|SMD|<0.2).

pair_separability_evidence.feature_space_gap: The 77-feature set contains NO destination-port feature (only 'Protocol'); destination port (21 FTP vs 80 HTTP) is the natural separator and is absent. This is the most likely missing discriminative signal.

feature_diagnostic.feature_arrays_loaded_note: Loaded via numpy mmap with a 20,000-per-class stratified cap (only the two classes' sampled rows were read; the full 6.74M-row array was NOT loaded).
feature_diagnostic.conclusion: FEATURE_LIMITED: SlowHTTPTest and FTP-BruteForce overlap in the current 77-feature space; a linear probe matches the deep model's separation ceiling (~0.68 balanced). Further model/loss experiments will redistribute the pair error (as EXP02/EXP03 did) but cannot reduce it. Only feature engineering / a new preprocessing protocol (e.g., restoring destination port and richer flow-timing/idle features) can raise the ceiling.

basis: Deep model and trivial linear probe reach the same ~0.68 balanced accuracy on the pair (no model headroom).
Only 3/77 features (one packet-rate axis) separate the classes; 74/77 have |SMD|<0.2.
Pair total confusion conserved across the entire loss-weight sweep (14,754 -> 14,758).
The natural separator (destination port) is absent from the feature space.

exp05_recommendation.reason: The pair is feature-limited: model/loss EXP05 (focal/class-balanced/weighting/two-stage) is proven futile for this pair (it only redistributes the conserved error). The only way to exceed the current ceiling is feature engineering (a new preprocessing protocol, e.g. restore destination port + flow-timing/idle features), which breaks comparability and needs a main-control decision. If that effort is not wanted, EXP03 1.25 is already a strong, honest final candidate (attack-family +0.0219, rare +0.0576 vs baseline, routing within noise) and should be promoted with the SlowHTTPTest/FTP and tiny-class limitations documented.

exp05_options.note: Model is at the feature ceiling for the pair; EXP03 1.25 is a strong honest improvement. Honest default.
Restore destination port + richer flow-timing/idle features; the only path to raise the ceiling. Breaks comparability; large effort.
Head-1 routing tool; recovers missed-as-benign; does NOT separate the pair. Useful for routing, not for this confusion.
Proven futile for a feature-limited pair; would only redistribute error and risk tiny-class instability (EXP03 1.35 precedent).
Conservation proves zero-sum on the pair; per-class hacking risk.
Cannot exceed the feature ceiling; deprioritized.
